guide.prio: Raise a Daze starter (Void Slash) with its Bash finishers (Splitting Slash, Ground Smash) first, then the Confusion pair (Lion's Roar with Gale Slash or Crescent Strike). Most skills get big boosts at Tier 5, 8, 9 and 10.

debuff.name: Daze
debuff.bonus: Void Slash and Body Check Daze for 5s; Splitting Slash and Ground Smash then deal Bash and DMG Boost +50% (Tier 1).

debuff.name: Confusion
debuff.bonus: Lion's Roar Dazes and Confuses for 5s; Gale Slash and Crescent Strike then deal Bash and DMG Boost +50% (Tier 1).

guide.pvp_bonus: Finishers deal Bash and DMG Boost +50% on Dazed (Splitting Slash, Ground Smash) or Confused targets (Gale Slash, Crescent Strike), Tier 1. Lion's Roar cuts enemy PHYS ATK by 80.

guide.prio: The two Chilled starters (Ravaging Blow, Ascending Dragon) and their finishers (Double Strike, Crescent Blade) first, cast by hand. Codex: PHYS ATK and Debilitation success boost so Chilled lands reliably.

debuff.name: Chilled

guide.pvp_bonus: Starters apply Chilled; on Chilled targets Bash always lands and Double Strike deals extra damage. Piercing Spear adds 1 hit near max range.

guide.note: We have not found a verified Darkist combo or leveling guide yet. Official notes say she is a ranged caster who weakens enemies with curses and poison; Backflow and Decay weaken targets before the damage skills.

items: Extra damage a skill deals when the target already has the debuff it needs. How much depends on the skill and its tier: Warrior finishers get +50% DMG boost on Dazed or Confused targets at Tier 1, and Splitting Slash +80% from Tier 8. Our sources give no figures for the other classes.
Triggers Bash (does not stack). Warrior finishers like Splitting Slash hit harder on Dazed targets.
Movement speed -50%. Triggers Bash, chance to Freeze (stun), DMG boost (max 3 stacks).
A debilitation effect; skills with Bash and DMG Boost on Quelled targets deal extra damage.
Name used in the Korean Taoist guide for the effect from Rain of Blades; Soaring Slash deals extra Bash damage to it. Our English sources do not define it further.
The target falls; keep attacking or move away while it is down.
